title: Portable Active Recovery under Timed and Position-Dependent Visual Outages
abstract: arXiv:2611.27121v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: When a camera blackout depends on physical position rather than elapsed time, stable hovering prevents visual recovery and mission completion. On stereo visual-inertial quadrotors without external localization, an exogenous timed blackout and an endogenous position-dependent dark zone appear identical at loss onset yet require opposite responses: hover-and-wait completes 93/96 timed blackouts but 0/96 spatial outages (13 hard failures), whereas blind continuation traverses many spatial zones yet fails heavily during timed blackouts. We formulate visual-outage recovery as a worst-condition active-observability problem and introduce a portable recovery module at the reference interface of an unchanged host controller with zero retraining. Using deployable telemetry alone, the module coordinates visual-loss detection, jerk-limited braking, bounded backward probing, settled rejoining, height-integral trim, and an optional gated prior-map bra

translated_title: 定时型与位置相关视觉中断下的可移植主动恢复
translated_abstract: 当相机失效取决于物理位置而非经过时间时，稳定悬停会阻碍视觉恢复与任务完成。在没有外部定位的双目视觉-惯性四旋翼无人机上，外部触发的定时中断与内生位置相关的黑暗区域在失效起始时表现完全相同，却需要截然相反的应对策略：悬停等待策略能完成93/96次定时中断恢复，但对空间中断的恢复率为0/96（13次硬故障）；而盲目继续飞行虽能穿越许多空间区域，却在定时中断中大量失败。我们将视觉中断恢复问题形式化为最坏条件下的主动可观测性问题，并在保持主机控制器不变的前提下，在其参考接口处引入一个可移植的恢复模块，实现零重训练。仅依靠可部署的遥测数据，该模块协调视觉丢失检测、加加速度受限的制动、有界后退探测、稳定重连、高度积分微调以及可选的门控先验地图……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了一个无需重训练、可移植的主动恢复模块，使无外部定位的双目视觉-惯性四旋翼无人机能够区分并正确应对定时型与位置相关两类视觉中断，通过协调检测、制动、后退探测与重连等行为实现最坏条件下的主动可观测性恢复。
en_tdlr: A portable, zero-retraining active recovery module that enables stereo visual-inertial quadrotors without external localization to distinguish and correctly respond to both timed and position-dependent visual outages by coordinating detection, jerk-limited braking, backward probing, and rejoining under worst-case observability conditions.
